newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-NATAL REACH SUPER 12 SEMIS DESPITE DRAW.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-NATAL REACH SUPER 12 SEMIS DESPITE DRAW.

text.p: A second-half comeback confirmed Natal's place in the Super 12 semifinals after a 27-27 draw with Northern Transvaal on Sunday.
Natal's three points from the match -- two for the draw and one for their tally of four tries -- was enough to join Auckland, Wellington and Australian Capital Territory in the knockout stage.
Natal, last year's losing finalists, made a flying start through a Gavin Lawless try after two minutes but the Blue Bulls countered with a try of their own 10 minutes later through Boeta Wessels.
Northern Transvaal went 14-5 ahead when Johan Schutte touched down under the posts and right wing Casper Steyn completed his second conversion.
Natal doubled their score through a soft try from John Allan but just before halftime the Blue Bulls moved to 24-10 with a Andre Snyman try.
Natal hit back strongly after the break with a Lawless penalty and a converted try by Adrian Garvey to cut Northerns' lead to 24-20.
Lawless then scored his second try after chasing down a Kevin Putt kick and a successful conversion put Natal ahead 27-24 before Steyn equalised with a long-range penalty.
